lines.en: I decide to spend the night hanging out in the dorm with Touka.
lines.zh: 我决定在宿舍陪 Touka 过夜。

lines.en: Despite the place being light years beneath her standards, she doesn't particularly seem to {i}hate{/i} things here.
lines.zh: 尽管这地方比她的标准低了十万八千里，她好像倒也不太{i}讨厌{/i}这儿。

lines.en: Granted, she spends most of her time either alone or on video calls with different instructors to make up for my inadequacy as a teacher-
lines.zh: 当然，她大部分时间不是独处，就是跟各路导师视频补课——好弥补我这个老师的「不合格」——

lines.en: But she hasn't asked for a transfer or gotten me fired yet, so that is a clear plus.
lines.zh: 但她既没要求换宿舍，也没把我弄开除，这就算个明显的好兆头。

lines.en: Eventually, she moves on to talking about her family's business and I can't help but begin to lose interest.
lines.zh: 后来，她转而聊起她家的生意，我忍不住开始走神。

lines.en: Her cuteness may get her far in life, and her great wealth may get her even further-
lines.zh: 她的可爱能让她在这世上走很远，她的巨额财富能让她走得更远——

lines.en: But it will not get her to the point where she can talk about boring stuff without risking my interest.
lines.zh: 可这没法让她做到「聊无聊的事还不让我走神」。

lines.en: And, obviously, I need to be the center of her affinities because this is a world made for me.
lines.zh: 而且，很显然，我必须是她「兴趣」的中心，因为这是个为我而生的世界。

lines.en: I convince Touka to leave her family and become my sex slave. She obliges and, within moments, we are naked.
lines.zh: 我说服 Touka 离开家族、来当我的性奴。她答应了，顷刻间我们就赤身裸体。

lines.en: I convince Touka to leave her family and open up an Arby's with me.
lines.zh: 我说服 Touka 离开家族、跟我开一家 Arby's。

lines.en: I never convince her to do any of that and, instead, decide to just head home.
lines.zh: 我根本没说服她做其中任何一件，而是直接决定回家。

lines.en: But at least the two of us managed to get a little closer.
lines.zh: 不过至少，我们俩总算又亲近了一点。
